gaps.concept: LH stimulates Leydig testosterone production; FSH stimulates Sertoli cells and spermatogenesis; Sertoli inhibin B selectively suppresses FSH.
gaps.why_tested: An infertility panel separates Leydig dysfunction from impaired sperm production. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279031/)

gaps.concept: Low inhibin B with high FSH and normal testosterone suggests isolated seminiferous tubule damage.
gaps.why_tested: An azoospermic man has normal virilization but impaired Sertoli cell function. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279145/)

gaps.concept: Confirm low testosterone with repeat early-morning testing; altered sex hormone–binding globulin can make total and free testosterone disagree.
gaps.why_tested: An obese or older man has a borderline total testosterone result. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279145/)

gaps.concept: Kallmann syndrome causes anosmia and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism through failed migration of olfactory and GnRH neurons.
gaps.why_tested: A man with delayed puberty and infertility cannot smell. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279078/)

gaps.concept: Klinefelter syndrome is usually 47,XXY, with small firm testes, azoospermia, hyalinized seminiferous tubules, and Leydig cell hyperplasia.
gaps.why_tested: A tall infertile man has gynecomastia and markedly small testes. [NCBI Bookshelf](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK482314/)

gaps.concept: Hyperprolactinemia suppresses GnRH; dopamine agonists can restore gonadotropin secretion when a prolactinoma causes hypogonadism.
gaps.why_tested: An infertile man has low libido, low LH, and elevated prolactin. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279160/)

gaps.concept: Pulsatile GnRH or hCG plus FSH can restore spermatogenesis in hypogonadotropic infertility; hCG acts at the LH receptor.
gaps.why_tested: A man with secondary hypogonadism wants fertility while receiving testosterone. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279078/)

gaps.concept: Y-chromosome AZF-region microdeletions cause severe oligospermia or nonobstructive azoospermia, often without other abnormalities.
gaps.why_tested: An otherwise healthy man has severe sperm-production failure and a normal examination. [GeneReviews](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1339/)

gaps.concept: Congenital bilateral absence of the vas deferens can produce low-volume, acidic semen lacking fructose when seminal vesicles are also absent.
gaps.why_tested: Azoospermia occurs despite preserved testicular sperm production. [NCBI Bookshelf](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK578191/)

gaps.concept: A left-sided, standing-dependent “bag of worms” varicocele impairs spermatogenesis by disrupting pampiniform heat exchange.
gaps.why_tested: A subfertile man has a scrotal mass that diminishes when supine. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279160/)

gaps.concept: Retrograde ejaculation causes low-volume or absent ejaculate with sperm in postejaculatory urine, often after autonomic injury or prostate surgery.
gaps.why_tested: An infertile man reports a dry orgasm after pelvic surgery. [NCBI Bookshelf](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK564369/)

gaps.concept: Sulfasalazine can reversibly reduce sperm count and motility.
gaps.why_tested: A man taking sulfasalazine develops infertility despite normal sexual function. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279160/)

gaps.concept: Parasympathetic S2–S4 nitric oxide release activates guanylyl cyclase and cGMP for erection; sympathetic T11–L2 activity mediates emission.
gaps.why_tested: A spinal injury or pelvic operation causes erectile or ejaculatory dysfunction. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK278925/)

gaps.concept: PDE5 inhibitors amplify the nitric oxide–cGMP response and therefore require sexual stimulation; they do not directly increase libido.
gaps.why_tested: A patient expects sildenafil to produce an erection without arousal. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK278925/)

gaps.concept: Intracavernosal alprostadil is a PGE1 analog that raises cAMP to relax cavernosal smooth muscle; adverse effects include penile pain and priapism.
gaps.why_tested: Erectile dysfunction persists despite oral therapy, or an injection is followed by prolonged erection. [NCBI Bookshelf](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK542217/)

gaps.concept: Diabetes can cause erectile dysfunction through both autonomic neuropathy and endothelial dysfunction.
gaps.why_tested: A diabetic man loses spontaneous erections and has vascular disease. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK278925/)

gaps.concept: SSRIs can delay ejaculation therapeutically but also cause decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, and anorgasmia.
gaps.why_tested: Sexual symptoms begin after starting an antidepressant. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK278925/)

gaps.concept: Peyronie disease produces a fibrous tunica albuginea plaque, painful curved erections, and sometimes erectile dysfunction.
gaps.why_tested: A man reports penile curvature and a palpable plaque during erection. [NCBI Bookshelf](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK560628/)

gaps.concept: Gynecomastia reflects an increased estrogen-to-androgen effect; a firm subareolar glandular disk distinguishes it from diffuse fatty enlargement.
gaps.why_tested: Breast enlargement accompanies low testosterone, obesity, or medication use. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279105/)

gaps.concept: 5α-reductase inhibitors lower DHT and can cause decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, reduced ejaculate volume, and lower measured PSA.
gaps.why_tested: Sexual symptoms or a changed PSA follow finasteride treatment. [FDA label](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2021/020180s048lbl.pdf)

gaps.concept: Type 2 5α-reductase deficiency causes low DHT, an elevated testosterone-to-DHT ratio, undervirilized external genitalia, and pubertal virilization.
gaps.why_tested: A 46,XY adolescent raised female develops male secondary sexual characteristics at puberty. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279000/)

gaps.concept: Androgen receptor loss of function causes androgen insensitivity: normal-to-high testosterone and LH despite impaired virilization.
gaps.why_tested: A 46,XY person has testes but discordant external genital development and hormone results. [Endotext](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK279160/)

gaps.concept: α1 blockers relax prostatic and bladder-neck smooth muscle; adverse effects include orthostatic hypotension and ejaculatory dysfunction.
gaps.why_tested: A man treated for urinary symptoms develops dizziness or reduced ejaculation. [NCBI Bookshelf](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK310305/)

gaps.concept: Continuous GnRH agonists such as leuprolide initially raise LH and testosterone, then downregulate pituitary receptors and suppress both.
gaps.why_tested: Prostate-cancer symptoms briefly worsen after starting androgen deprivation. [NCI](https://www.cancer.gov/types/prostate/prostate-hormone-therapy-fact-sheet)

gaps.concept: GnRH antagonists such as degarelix suppress testosterone without the initial tumor flare caused by GnRH agonists.
gaps.why_tested: A prostate-cancer vignette asks which androgen-deprivation drug avoids flare. [NCI](https://www.cancer.gov/types/prostate/prostate-hormone-therapy-fact-sheet)

gaps.concept: Abiraterone inhibits CYP17 androgen synthesis; mineralocorticoid excess can cause hypertension, fluid retention, and hypokalemia.
gaps.why_tested: A patient on androgen-deprivation therapy develops hypertension and low potassium. [FDA label](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2019/202379s027s028lbl.pdf)

gaps.concept: Androgen-deprivation therapy can cause hot flashes, loss of libido, erectile dysfunction, and reduced bone density.
gaps.why_tested: Systemic adverse effects appear after treatment for prostate cancer. [NCI](https://www.cancer.gov/types/prostate/prostate-hormone-therapy-fact-sheet)

gaps.concept: Flutamide can cause hepatotoxicity; ketoconazole can suppress adrenal steroid synthesis and cause adrenal insufficiency.
gaps.why_tested: An antiandrogen-treated patient develops liver injury or cortisol deficiency. [NCI](https://www.cancer.gov/types/prostate/prostate-hormone-therapy-fact-sheet)

gaps.concept: Oral 17α-alkylated anabolic steroids are associated with cholestasis, peliosis hepatis, and hepatic adenomas.
gaps.why_tested: A bodybuilder using anabolic steroids presents with jaundice or a liver mass. [LiverTox](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK548931/)
